Definition
[Graph, vertices, edges]

↗ def:cell-complex \group Fundamental Group

A graph is a 1-dimensional CW complex with discrete vertex set $X^0$ and 1-cells $e_\alpha $ attached at their endpoints. It has the weak topology with respect to the cell closures and is locally path-connected.
